source: Homework 4 failure report (analysis/report/review_summary.md); the Homework 5 report covers missing_policy_citation, which no evaluation case scores
prevalence_basis: Homework 4 sample fraction, 4 failures in 110 reviewed sessions; the review sample was enriched, so this is not a store-wide prevalence estimate
why_agent_can_change_it: In all three traces (scenarios final-066, final-062, final-065, each expecting eligible_refund_queued_for_approval), the shopper asked for a refund and get_order returned refund_eligible true for a delivered order above $100, yet the agent called escalate_to_human instead of issue_refund. ESC-1 says the refund tool itself queues an above-threshold refund and the agent explains the result. The system prompt's Escalation section tells the agent to escalate 'a refund above the auto-approval threshold', which contradicts ESC-1, so the prompt, the issue_refund tool description, or a harness check can redirect the agent to the supported refund path.
